title: A critical bug on Android in the code "dir_access_jandroid Condition 'id == 0'"
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible - Godot Engine 4.6.2 or 4.6
Not Reproducible - Godot Engine 4.5 ar older

### System information

Godot Engine 4.6.2, Compatlity, Android 15, Tecno Spark Go 2, 4/128 GB, UnisocT7250, 8 Core

### Issue description

Hello Godot Engine developers, whilst developing my game for Android and creating the in-game "File Explorer", I encountered the following error: "E 0:00:11:925   main_explorer_file.gd:211 @ _add_tree_items(): Condition "id == 0" is true. Returning: ""
  <C++ source> platform/android/dir_access_jandroid.cpp:67 @ get_next()". I haven’t been able to fix it, even after getting advice from the support team, and it turned out that I had indeed found a bug on Android, and the AI has already clarified this: it’s a bug in your own engine that needs fixing, preferably by version 4.7 or 4.6.3 if possible, as this is quite a serious issue, especially when creating the "File Explorer" tool. Therefore, I would like you to fix the error in your engine so that it runs stably on your engine.

### Steps to reproduce

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9b22d79c-c92d-4a76-ab45-fb794b90bb4c

To recreate this, I need to give you this file, which I’m using to create the game.

1. Download this file, Retyzaliton-Hayexs.7z, to your smartphone.

2. Launch the game until you reach the main menu.

3. Next to the icon with the code, there is a folder icon; tap it.

4. Once you’ve tapped it, the File Explorer should appear.

5. Navigate to, for example, the Android folder, and then tap the data folder.

6. After that, exit the game and return to the editor.

7. Finally, open "Debug" and you should see the error "Condition 'id == 0' is true. Returning: "" in your file 'dir_access_jandroid.cpp:67'

Additional steps: To view "File Explorer" with the folder icon, you need to follow these steps.

1. If you are in the Main Menu, click "Settings".

2. Next, look for the "Tool Settings" tab.

3. You will find the "Enable File Explorer" button on the first panel.

4. Enable this tool, return to the Main Menu, and you will see a button with a folder icon.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Retyzaliton-Hayexs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26662147/Retyzaliton-Hayexs.zip)

Please note: this file will remain valid until 1 January 2027; after this date, it will no longer be valid and will cease to function.
